name: browser-use
headline: multimodal report generation with Claude Skills
short_description: Automates report generation from mixed-format files. Operations teams use it to convert documents, images, and audio/video into structured, template-based reports. Connects to a custom MCP server for processing.
author: umairalipathan1980

sections.overview:
This skill automates the transformation of mixed-format meeting materials—audio recordings, handwritten notes, diagrams, digital notes, and supplementary documents—into professionally formatted Word deliverables. It works by collecting input files from a designated folder, transcribing audio/video via an integrated MCP server, interpreting images, and generating a structured report with sections like meeting summary, decisions, action items, and follow-up messages. The skill supports 20+ file formats and adapts its output based on optional templates and sample documents you provide. Operations teams, project managers, and engineering leads benefit by eliminating manual transcription and document compilation work, turning hours of post-meeting effort into minutes.
Converting recorded team meetings into meeting minutes with transcribed audio and extracted decisions
Processing handwritten notes and diagrams from whiteboard sessions into formal documentation
Combining multi-format meeting materials (slides, notes, recordings, PDFs) into a single Word report
Generating action item tables with owners and due dates from unstructured meeting content
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/umairalipathan1980/Claude-Skill-for-Multimodal-Report-Generation`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a comprehensive report from the following mixed-format files: [FILE1], [FILE2], [FILE3]. Use the [COMPANY] branding guidelines and [INDUSTRY] standards. The report should include an executive summary, key findings, and actionable recommendations. Format the output as a Word document using the [TEMPLATE_NAME] template.
```
Copy

```
# Executive Summary

The following report synthesizes insights from a recent client meeting, combining notes, presentation slides, and audio recordings. The meeting focused on strategic initiatives for [COMPANY], a leader in the [INDUSTRY] sector.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
